chunks: It is narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:
The Righteous Servant, peace be upon him, said: “It is not proper for one who is called to a testimony to hold back from it.”

key_terms.الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ: a title used here for the Imam, the righteous servant
key_terms.شَهَادَةٍ: testimony or witness-bearing in a legal or formal matter
key_terms.يَتَقَاعَسَ: to hold back, refrain, or be reluctant

ai.seo_question: Should a person refrain when called to give testimony?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that a person called upon to give testimony should not shrink back or refuse to do so. It emphasizes the ethical and legal importance of fulfilling one's duty in establishing truth and protecting the rights of others.
